name: Commercial Trade
definition: Commercial details of a trade transaction between a buyer and a seller.

TotalAcceptedAmount.name: Total Accepted Amount
TotalAcceptedAmount.definition: Total amount of a trade, that is the sum of the accepted items.

PurchaseAccount.name: Purchase Account
PurchaseAccount.definition: Specific purchase account for recording debits and credits for accounting purposes.

PaymentObligation.name: Payment Obligation
PaymentObligation.definition: Obligation for the buyer to settle the value of the products bought.

PartyRole.name: Party Role
PartyRole.definition: Role played by a party in the context of a trade.

TradeSettlement.name: Trade Settlement
TradeSettlement.definition: Process of settling a commercial trade.

ProductDeliveryObligation.name: Product Delivery Obligation
ProductDeliveryObligation.definition: Obligation for the seller to deliver the products to the buyer.

PurchaseOrder.name: Purchase Order
PurchaseOrder.definition: Specifies the purchase order related to a commercial trade.

Documents.name: Documents
Documents.definition: Documents related to                             a commercial trade transaction.

RelatedUndertaking.name: Related Undertaking
RelatedUndertaking.definition: Undertaking related to the commercial trade.

TransactionStatus.name: Transaction Status
TransactionStatus.definition: Status of a commercial trade processed in a central system.

Agreement.name: Agreement
Agreement.definition: Agreement between trade parties which describes the conditions under which they agree to execute trades amongst themselves.
